"""Regression test for FND-000001 - SQL injection in find_account_by_name.

Both tests must FAIL against the unpatched code, for two different reasons. That is
what makes them proof rather than decoration.
"""

from ledger import db


def conn():
    return db.bootstrap(db.connect())


def test_quote_in_name_is_data_not_syntax():
    """Unpatched, the payload closes the quote and matches every row."""
    assert db.find_account_by_name(conn(), "' OR '1'='1") == []


def test_legitimate_quote_still_matches():
    """Unpatched, this raises an OperationalError. A fix that strips quotes instead of
    parameterizing would break every customer whose name contains one."""
    rows = db.find_account_by_name(conn(), "O'Brien Holdings")
    assert len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]["balance"] == 250
